content.title: How To Watch Oscars 2026 Tonight On Streaming And Free TV: Start Time And More
content.text: Host US comedian Conan O'Brien is featured on an Oscars billboard outside the Dolby Theatre ahead of the 98th Annual Academy Awards in Hollywood, California, on March 13, 2026. (Photo by ANGELA WEISS / AFP via Getty Images)AFP via Getty ImagesThe 98th Academy Awards are tonight, and it appears that Sinners and One Battle After Another will be battling it out for the top Oscars following major guild wins by both films in the final stretch of awards season.Both Sinners, which is going into the ceremony with a record 16 nominations, and One Battle After Another, which follows with 13 nods are both nominated for Best Picture. Also, in the running for Best Picture are Bugonia, F1: The Movie, Frankenstein, Hamnet, Marty Supreme, The Secret Agent and Train Dreams.ForbesOscars 2026 Predictions: Who Will Win Best Picture, Best Actor, Best DirectorBy Tim LammersOne Battle After Another mostly dominated awards season, but Sinners’ win for Outstanding Ensemble Cast at The Actor Awards on March 1 considerably narrowed the gap between the two films in the path to the Best Picture Oscar.The 2026 Oscars ceremony will begin airing on ABC and streaming on Hulu (on Disney+) at 7 p.m. ET/4 p.m. PT. Conan O’Brien, who hosted the 2025 ceremony, returns to emcee Sunday night’s festivities. The 98th annual event is taking place at the Dolby Theater at Ovation Hollywood in Los Angeles.MORE FOR YOUForbesHow To Watch Oscars 2026 Red Carpet Arrivals On Streaming And Free TVBy Tim LammersFor viewers who prefer to watch the Oscars on streaming, Hulu is available on the Disney+ platform for $12.99 per month with ads or $19.99 per month without ads.In addition, the Oscars will also stream on other subscription services including YouTubeTV, AT&T TV and FuboTV and Hulu + Live TV. For viewers who miss watching the ceremony, it will be available to stream on Hulu on Disney+ on Monday. Email Address Atmosphere at the 98th Academy Awards Nominations Announcement held at the Samuel Goldwyn Theatre on January 22, 2026 in Beverly Hills, California. (Photo by Gilbert Flores/Variety via Getty Images)Variety via Getty ImagesTimothée Chalamet And Michael B. Jordan Are In The Tightest Competition Of The NightIn the Best Actor category, the nominees are Timothée Chalamet (Marty Supreme), Leonardo DiCaprio (One Battle After Another), Ethan Hawke (Blue Moon), Michael B. Jordan (Sinners) and Wagner Moura (The Secret Agent) .Chalamet seemed to have an unfettered path to the Oscar after winning several critics’ awards for his performance in the sports comedy until he hit roadblocks at the British Academy of Film and Television Arts Awards and The Actor Awards, where he lost to Robert Aramayo (for I Swear) and Jordan in upset wins.ForbesOscars 2026: Here’s The Complete List Of NomineesBy Tim LammersSince Aramayo is not nominated – I Swear will not be released in the U.S. until April – Jordan now has the inside track to take the Best Actor Oscar.In the race for the Best Actress Oscar, the nominees are Jessie Buckley (Hamnet), Rose Byrne (If I Had Legs I’d Kick You), Kate Hudson (Song Sung Blue), Renate Reinsve (Sentimental Value) and Emma Stone (Bugonia). Buckley seems to be one of a few locks on Oscar night, since she previously won a bevy of critics’ awards in addition to wins in the category from the BAFTAs and The Actor Awards. ForbesWarner Bros. Tries To Fend Off The Rest Of Hollywood For Oscars GloryBy Jair HilburnSinners and One Battle After Another are also facing off in the Best Directing category, with Ryan Coogler up for the honor for directing the vampire thriller and Paul Thomas Anderson helming the action-comedy. Anderson has the apparent edge in the category with a Directors Guild of America win under his belt, since the DGA is historically one of the most accurate predictors of who takes home the Best Directing Oscar.Also nominated for Best Director are Chloé Zhao for Hamnet, Josh Safdie for Marty Supreme and Joachim Trier for Sentimental Value.The 2026 Oscars will air live on ABC and stream on Hulu at 7 p.m. ET/4 p.m. PT.ForbesDo The Academy Awards Still Matter To Most Americans?By Rick Ellis
